args: Analyze yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point in yara/libyara/re.c, especially unlinking the selected child from the root CONCAT around lines 502-565. What invariants must be maintained for children_head, children_tail, prev_sibling, and next_sibling, and is setting root_node->children_head when child->prev_sibling is NULL the complete root-cause fix? Identify edge cases such as sole, head, middle, and tail children.

The supplied ASan report shows a heap-use-after-free in yr_re_node_destroy after yr_re_ast_split_at_chaining_point frees an ungreedy RE_NODE_RANGE_ANY chaining point. The PoC `rule r{strings:$=/.{,}?/` creates a root CONCAT with the chaining point as its sole child. Existing code reportedly updates children_tail and sibling links but fails to update root_node->children_head, leaving it dangling. I am inspecting the exact implementation before making a narrowly scoped C source patch under yara.
